[2026-08-31T02:54:27.917Z] [arbiter] A Reclaimer foreman taps the open shaft. "Down there is one of nine. Asgardar, Samarran, Nimari, Drakova, Voronov — the original five. Karok-Sa, Yuldra-Tul, Ostragar, Iskan-Veil — the four we have only re-confirmed in the last decade. Tools first; we'll teach you the trick at each site."
[2026-08-31T02:54:27.917Z] [world] Half of Nimari is under the silt; the half that isn't is red. The Red Tower throws a long rust-coloured shadow across drowned streets, and somewhere inside it a working Aetheric core pulses warm enough that the mud around your boots steams faintly.
[2026-08-31T02:54:27.917Z] [arbiter] (Reclaimer route — to recover the Nimari Core, SALVAGE something here. The Aetheric housing comes loose under the right trowel.)
[2026-08-31T02:54:27.918Z] [arbiter] The Arbiter's voice drops. "This is one of the nine Lost Capitals — and it holds a Core, the whole reason we walk. Open CONTRACTS, find the Primary Objective, and press ★ SUMMON to call up this pla
ce's Guardian. Put it down and the Core is yours. That is the main road; everything else is a detour."
[2026-08-31T02:54:31.766Z] [arbiter] They do not seem surprised, which is the first bad sign, and they have a word for it, which is the second. It is an old word and they use it carefully. They ask to hear it — to sit with you in a dry room while it happens and write down what you say — and they 
pay for the privilege, and by the third session you understand that you are not the one being studied. Not primarily.
[2026-08-31T02:54:31.768Z] [reward] +180 TC.
[2026-08-31T02:54:31.769Z] [system] Word moves through the buried world — many people view you differently now.
